issues.failure_explanation: Real eigenvalues of the nonsymmetric matrix D^{-1}W lying in [-1,1] do not bound its Euclidean quadratic form or the eigenvalues of its symmetric part. Hence D^{-1}W+2I has a negative quadratic direction.
